subtitle: Restore missing vowels
short_description: Fill in the missing vowels to restore each short phrase.
description:
Each phrase appears with its vowels removed, leaving only the consonants. Using the topic clue, insert A, E, I, O or U into each blank to restore the phrase.

Tap a blank, then choose a letter on the large A, E, I, O, U keypad. Erase clears a blank.

Six original boards, each unlocking the next once solved. Undo and Restart are always available, there is no timer, and your progress saves on this device. Plays offline. No ads, no account, no data collection.
